_meta.hard_truth: This is a casual Hijazi eatery; كرك هندي is the hero drink; shawarma is the hero food; NO alcohol, NO mixed-gender intimacy scenes — public café/street settings only.
_meta.signature_serving_system: Branded paper cups for drinks (karak, Arabic coffee); white kraft wrap for shawarma; round foil trays for sharing platters. Woven palm-leaf place mats or plain wooden tables. Condensation on cold drinks, steam on hot ones.

كرك هندي.identity_dna: A creamy, deep-amber Indian-spiced milk tea — simmered with cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves — poured steaming into a branded paper cup with a snug lid. The colour is warm toffee-brown, the surface glossy from condensed milk. It is THE Saudi café ritual drink: warming, sweet, and ordered by the tray at offices and Thursday gatherings.
كرك هندي.signature: Toffee-brown creamy tea, steaming in a branded paper cup — the defining shared-sip of any Saudi gathering
كرك هندي.texture: Silky, warm, slightly viscous from the milk reduction; aromatic steam rises from the lid vent

شاورما دجاج.identity_dna: A tightly wrapped shawarma sandwich — grilled, marinated chicken shaved off a rotating spit, layered with garlic sauce (toum), pickled turnips, and crispy onion, all folded inside a warm khobz flatbread. The exterior shows char marks and golden grill blistering; the interior steams when unwrapped.
شاورما دجاج.signature: Warm charred flatbread wrap, bulging with garlic-sauced chicken and pickled pink turnips — held in one hand
شاورما دجاج.texture: Crispy-edged flatbread exterior, soft inside; juicy tender chicken with tart pickling contrast

قهوة عربية بالهيل.identity_dna: Light golden Gulf coffee (قهوة خفيفة) — steeped with cardamom and a whisper of saffron, poured from a brass dallah into a small handleless finjan cup. The colour is pale yellow-gold, completely clear, and aromatic. Served with a side of Medjool dates on a small wooden tray.
قهوة عربية بالهيل.signature: Pale golden coffee in a white finjan cup, with a gleaming brass dallah and dates beside it — the Saudi hospitality icon
قهوة عربية بالهيل.texture: Clear, light-bodied, warmly aromatic; dates contrast sweet and chewy against the bitter floral coffee

منقوش جبن.identity_dna: A freshly baked Levantine-style flatbread (خبز طابون) spread edge-to-edge with soft white cheese (جبن عكاوي or akkawi), blistered golden from the oven — thin, foldable, with a soft doughy interior and a slightly crispy charred bottom. Eaten folded or flat, still warm from the bread oven.
منقوش جبن.signature: Golden-blistered flatbread covered wall to wall in melted white cheese, served warm and foldable
منقوش جبن.texture: Soft, chewy doughy interior; lightly crisp charred bottom; cheese melted through and gooey at the center

كوكتيل تمر بالحليب.identity_dna: A thick, creamy date-and-milk smoothie — blended Medjool dates with cold whole milk and a pinch of cardamom, the colour deep caramel-brown, served in a tall branded glass or sealed cup with a straw. It is sweet, nourishing, and unmistakably Saudi in its use of dates as the primary sweetener.
كوكتيل تمر بالحليب.signature: Thick caramel-brown date shake, served in a tall sealed cup with straw — naturally sweet, no added sugar
كوكتيل تمر بالحليب.texture: Thick and creamy like a milkshake; tiny date fibre bits through the smoothness; cold and filling

بسبوسة بالقشطة.identity_dna: A moist, golden semolina cake (بسبوسة) soaked in rose-water sugar syrup, topped with a dollop of thick Saudi clotted cream (قشطة) and garnished with crushed pistachios. The surface glistens from the syrup soak; the cream is pure white against the honey-amber cake.
بسبوسة بالقشطة.signature: Syrup-glossed golden semolina cake square topped with white clotted cream and green pistachio crumble
بسبوسة بالقشطة.texture: Moist, tender, slightly grainy from semolina; sweet and floral from rose syrup; cream adds cool richness

فطيرة بالجبن والعسل.identity_dna: A hot pocket pastry (فطيرة) made from thin buttered dough layers, filled with soft white cheese and finished with a golden honey drizzle on top. The exterior is flaky and blistered from the griddle; the cheese melts and the honey caramelises slightly at the edges.
فطيرة بالجبن والعسل.signature: Hot flaky pastry pocket oozing white cheese with a golden honey drizzle — sweet-salty Saudi street snack
فطيرة بالجبن والعسل.texture: Shatteringly crisp layered exterior; molten cheese centre; honey adds sticky sweetness at the fold

سندويش فلافل.identity_dna: A hand-held falafel sandwich — crispy deep-green chickpea falafel balls, still hot, stuffed into a fresh khobz half with shredded white cabbage, sliced tomato, parsley, and a drizzle of tahini sauce, wrapped in wax paper. Eaten standing at the counter or in a car — the ultimate Saudi street lunch.
سندويش فلافل.signature: Hot crispy falafel in a warm khobz half, stuffed with crunchy vegetables and white tahini — wrapped in wax paper
سندويش فلافل.texture: Crunchy shatteringly crisp falafel exterior, soft herb-green inside; bread soft; cabbage gives fresh crunch
